This is a second, optional accessibility service called Aurora Web & content Shield.

Everything Aurora does, in four places.
Create Shields and Intents, start them from Home, and see how it went in Track.
Start a session by adding your own Shields and Intents to it. Then choose to start it now or later, create a schedule, or let it run always.
Save a session while creating one, so you can start it instantly: tap a saved session and choose a time.
A Shield protects you from apps, websites or parts of apps, with a range of ways to block them.
Creating a Shield never starts it. Start it from Home, alone or inside a saved session.
An Intent makes sure you use your apps intentionally, not out of impulse, by asking whether you really want to use an app whenever you open it.
Creating an Intent never starts it. Start it from Home, alone or inside a saved session.
